description: List the tailnets in your organization, including API-only tailnets created via the API. Paginated: returns at most `limit` results (Tailscale defaults to 100) plus a `cursor`. Pass that cursor back to fetch the next page; an empty cursor in the response means you have reached the end. Requires OAuth authentication.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Max tailnets to return in this page. Omit to use Tailscale's default of 100.

organization.description: Organization ID. Defaults to '-' (the organization owning the calling credentials).

name: tailscale_list_org_tailnets
title: List organization tailnets
